risk_note: RV2 ledger (B2-02s; BR-FUND-19; FU-B202R-DONE-MARK). The daily handler, once the runner and the B2-02p execution step have finished, records (app, D) as done in app.processed_events (consumer ledger.daily_check_done, deterministic uuid) in the same transaction that enqueues D+1 (INSERT … ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING); stateOf / heal treat that record as done before looking at the queue, so a completed day whose attempts overran expireInSeconds and went to dead is no longer re-sent; a handler that throws writes no record. No migration.
